tracesTo: UserFlow: Weekly Member Engagement, Feed Interaction, Pick'ems & History Browsing

stories.title: View Winners Bracket for Standard Playoff Format
stories.goal: see the championship bracket with all playoff teams and matchup progression
stories.benefit: I can follow the path to the championship and understand playoff structure
acceptanceCriteria: System displays bracket with seeds based on league playoff settings
Bracket shows all playoff rounds from first round through championship
Each bracket slot shows team logo, name, and seed number
Matchup winners advance to next round with visual connection lines
Completed matchups show final scores and indicate winner

stories.title: View Losers/Toilet Bowl Bracket
stories.goal: see the consolation bracket for teams eliminated from championship contention
stories.benefit: I can track the consolation games and toilet bowl progression for non-playoff or eliminated teams
acceptanceCriteria: System displays separate losers bracket if league settings enable consolation games
Losers bracket shows teams not in or eliminated from winners bracket
Bracket structure mirrors league consolation playoff configuration
System clearly labels bracket as consolation or toilet bowl
Losers bracket displays alongside or separate from winners bracket based on UI design
Bracket respects league-specific naming (e.g., Toilet Bowl, Consolation, Sacko)

stories.title: Display Dynamic Bracket Layout Based on League Settings
stories.goal: see a bracket layout that matches my league's specific playoff configuration
stories.benefit: I get an accurate representation regardless of league size, playoff team count, or structure
acceptanceCriteria: System reads league playoff settings from external platform (number of playoff teams, rounds, byes)
Bracket dynamically generates rounds based on playoff team count (4-team, 6-team, 8-team, etc.)
System handles first-round byes by showing top seeds advancing automatically to second round
Bracket adjusts for custom playoff structures if platform supports them
Layout is responsive and adapts to available screen space without horizontal scrolling on desktop
System handles edge cases like 3-team playoffs or unconventional bracket structures

stories.title: View Forward-Looking Placeholder Teams
stories.goal: see placeholders for teams that will advance from previous rounds
stories.benefit: I understand bracket structure even when future matchups are not yet determined
acceptanceCriteria: Undetermined matchups show placeholder text (e.g., 'Winner of [Matchup A] vs [Matchup B]')
Placeholders reference the specific previous-round matchups by team names or seeds
Placeholders update to actual teams once previous round matchups are completed
System maintains placeholder structure for all future rounds at start of playoffs
Visual styling distinguishes placeholders from confirmed teams (e.g., grayed out, dashed border)

stories.title: Automatic Round Progression and Winner Advancement
stories.goal: see teams automatically move forward in the bracket as games complete
stories.benefit: I have an up-to-date view of playoff progression without manual updates
acceptanceCriteria: System fetches playoff matchup results from external fantasy platform API
Winners automatically populate next round matchup slots after current round completes
Bracket updates reflect latest data based on sync schedule (e.g., hourly during playoffs)
System handles stat corrections by updating bracket if winners change due to late corrections
Automatic advancement respects league playoff schedule and round timing
User can manually trigger bracket refresh to get latest results

stories.title: Display Matchup Scores Within Bracket
stories.goal: see scores for each playoff matchup directly in the bracket view
stories.benefit: I can assess competitiveness and outcomes without navigating away from bracket
acceptanceCriteria: Each bracket matchup displays current or final scores next to team names
In-progress matchups show live scores that update based on sync frequency
Completed matchups show final scores with decimal precision
System indicates matchup status (scheduled, live, final) with visual cues
Scores are displayed clearly without cluttering bracket visual design
System handles pre-game matchups by showing empty scores or projected scores

stories.title: Indicate Current Playoff Round
stories.goal: quickly identify which round of the playoffs is currently active
stories.benefit: I know where we are in the playoff timeline without confusion
acceptanceCriteria: System highlights or labels the current active round in the bracket
Current round indicator updates automatically as playoffs progress
Visual styling emphasizes current round (e.g., bolder text, highlight color, border)
System shows round names/labels (e.g., Quarterfinals, Semifinals, Championship)
Past rounds are visually de-emphasized but remain visible for context
Future rounds are shown with placeholder styling

stories.title: Navigate Between Playoff Seasons
stories.goal: view playoff brackets from previous seasons to review historical outcomes
stories.benefit: I can compare playoff results across years and see dynasty continuity
acceptanceCriteria: Season selector dropdown is available on bracket page
User can select past seasons to load historical playoff brackets
Historical brackets show completed results with final scores and champions
System loads brackets for all available seasons with playoff data
Current season is selected by default when page loads
Dynasty leagues show all historical seasons, redraft leagues show independent season brackets

stories.title: Display Playoff Seeding and Team Records
stories.goal: see playoff seed numbers and regular season records for context
stories.benefit: I understand how teams earned their playoff positions and bracket placement
acceptanceCriteria: Each team in bracket displays their playoff seed number (e.g., #1, #2)
System shows regular season record alongside team name (e.g., 10-4)
Seeding determines bracket matchup positions according to league rules
System highlights division winners or special seeding if applicable
Records and seeds are sourced from external platform league data
Visual design integrates seeding and records without cluttering bracket

stories.title: View Championship and Third Place Matchups
stories.goal: see the championship game and third-place game as distinct final matchups
stories.benefit: I can track both the ultimate winner and third-place finisher clearly
acceptanceCriteria: Championship matchup is prominently displayed at the top or end of bracket
Third-place game is shown separately if league settings enable it
System labels championship and third-place games clearly
Winner of championship is visually celebrated or highlighted (e.g., trophy icon, special styling)
System handles leagues without third-place games by omitting that matchup
Final standings are implied by bracket outcomes (1st, 2nd, 3rd place visible)

stories.title: Responsive Mobile Bracket View
stories.goal: view and navigate the playoff bracket on my mobile device
stories.benefit: I have a usable bracket experience on smaller screens without losing information
acceptanceCriteria: Bracket layout adapts to mobile viewport with vertical or collapsible structure
User can tap to expand/collapse rounds or sections to manage screen space
Team names, seeds, and scores remain legible on small screens
Connection lines between matchups are simplified or adjusted for mobile layout
User can scroll or swipe to navigate through rounds if horizontal space is limited
Bracket maintains visual hierarchy and clarity on mobile devices

stories.title: Display First-Round Byes for Top Seeds
stories.goal: see that top-seeded teams receive first-round byes and automatically advance
stories.benefit: I understand the advantage of higher seeding and bracket structure
acceptanceCriteria: System displays bye indicators for top seeds in first round (e.g., 'BYE' label)
Top seeds with byes appear directly in second round matchup slots
Bracket visually connects bye teams to their second-round opponents
System respects league playoff settings for how many teams receive byes (typically 1 or 2)
Bye teams are clearly distinguished from teams playing in first round
Bracket structure adjusts round labels to account for bye week
